successful_case_oracle_method: In each independent three-process E2E fixture, the controller recombines P0/P1 TEST_ONLY output mask shares with XOR, compares each original-order bit against frozen top_k_mask(scores,K), and asserts the recombined Hamming weight is exactly K. The fresh target emitted a per-case PASS line; all 18 success cases are represented below.
abort_case_method: Fault branch checks party and/or Dealer exits nonzero, reads no encoded mask for each party, emits a fault CASE_JSON record, and the target completes with exit 0.
